text:
mia: New hire hit quickstart friction: `redwoodctl login --headless` never returns when running sample app in Docker.

drew: what does the CLI print?

mia: `login failed: dial tcp 127.0.0.1:12345: connect: connection refused`. Browser shows callback sent to host but CLI didn't accept it.

sam: redwoodctl binds headless callback to 127.0.0.1 by default. In container/VM setups that will break. We have undocumented `--local-callback-host` but quickstart doesn't mention it.

mia: could we detect common container envs and print an actionable hint? e.g., "If using Docker, try `--local-callback-host=0.0.0.0` or use `--device-code` for CI"

drew: yes. Short fixes: 1) postinstall message update to advertise `--profile quickstart` and `--device-code` as fallbacks, 2) add a doctor check to detect Docker/WSL and suggest `--local-callback-host`, 3) make retry backoff less spammy.

sam: also for corp proxies we see `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority`. We should detect that specific error and print: "Tip: corp TLS inspection? Add your CA to system trust or use `--trust-local-ca /path/to/ca.pem` for headless auth (dev-only)"

mia: agreed. please keep `--trust-local-ca` scoped to the login session and never persist to system stores.

ci-bot: deploy-check: docs branch `devex/cli-bind-deviceflow` passed lints

drew: I'll open a small PR to change the postinstall text and doctor hints. Sam will take the error-message mapping and backoff changes.

sam: tagging devex and eng-platform. thanks!
